decisions.reason: For a wholesaler, listing a distributed perfect binder costs little, and with no evidence since 2019 its value is still uncertain, so the option is worth keeping open, though a supplier model update could replace it.
The fully automatic binder complements the manual model at low holding cost, and nothing in the results shows its value will not be realized, so keeping it is the sensible option.
The inline/nearline booklet maker extends the finishing range cheaply, and the lack of negative signals argues for keeping the option open rather than abandoning it.
